description: This Java class `DefaultPersistenceIdsConfig` implements configuration logic for persistence IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It reads configuration parameters such as burst, timeouts, backoff durations, and maximum restarts from a config source, and provides accessor methods for these properties.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceIdsConfig
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the `PersistenceIdsConfig` interface, encapsulating configuration parameters related to persistence IDs, with methods for retrieval and standard object overrides.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of `DefaultPersistenceIdsConfig` from a configuration source.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the burst value for persistence ID configuration.

methods.name: getStreamRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the stream request timeout duration.

methods.name: getStreamIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the stream idle timeout duration.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of restarts allowed.
